comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Motors, drives and motion control sold to industrial, medical, aerospace OEMs; matches AMETEK's Electromechanical Group.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Diversified engineered industrial maker with aerospace sensors, connectors and measurement products sold to OEMs, plus aftermarket; acquisitive like AMETEK.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Distributor of MRO supplies and fasteners; resells others' products rather than manufacturing instruments.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Electronic components and fastener distributor; not a manufacturer of instruments or electromechanical products.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Diversified engineered products maker: aerospace/defense components, utility test instruments, RF test; similar niche, acquisitive profile and customers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Mostly pumps, valves, brake pads and shock absorbers for automotive and flow control; little instrumentation overlap.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Niche precision measurement instruments with calibration services sold to nuclear, defense, medical and industrial customers, like AMETEK's instruments.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Telecom network test and optical coatings focus; different end market and software-heavy model versus AMETEK's industrial instruments.
